description: Export one job's Project To-do assignments as the canonical spreadsheet-formula-neutralized CSV. The worker_email column is redacted on agent surfaces (personal emails never leave the platform). The export is one response with no row cap (one row per person and assigned to-do). delivery=inline (default) returns the CSV in structuredContent. delivery=resource returns a compact receipt (rowCount, asOf, filename, byteSize, sha256, contentType, resourceUri) plus a resource_link; the rows never enter the result — read opentrain://jobs/{jobId}/project-todos/export/csv when you need the bytes. Both deliveries are bounded by the export route's response, which the hosting platform caps at about 4.5 MB of JSON (HTTP 413 above it, on every surface); the resource's own 20 MiB ceiling is not reached in practice. There is NO snapshot: a resource read re-fetches the LIVE export, so its _meta.sha256 equals the receipt hash only if no row changed in between. Cost: the receipt is a few hundred bytes, but receipt + read is larger than the inline result; use resource when you need only the receipt or your host keeps resource bytes out of your context. Requires project_todos:read scope.

delivery.description: inline (default): the CSV body in structuredContent. resource: a receipt and a resource_link only; read the resource for the bytes.

name: opentrain_export_project_todos_csv
